comparison.name: Protego
comparison.summary: Pure-Python robots.txt parser with support for modern conventions

comparison.name: robotexclusionrulesparser
comparison.summary: A robots.txt parser alternative to Python's robotparser module

choice: Protego is a maintained Scrapy-project pure-Python parser providing pattern and URL matching with no transitive dependencies. Pin 0.7.0; do not implement a wildcard matcher. Old stdlib group/literal rules remain the permission upper bound.
dependency_changes: One package added, no existing locked package versions changed. PyPI official metadata/package endpoints only.
initial_local_attempts: Installed uv did not support --exact; explicit == version used.
Default uv cache path read-only; task-specific /tmp cache used. No network/TLS/proxy/UA changes.
